name: Syral Bladeleaf
summary: In Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf guides night elves arriving from Shadowglen. She speaks for the Council of the Forest and directs newcomers to the caretakers, herbalists, and elders who tend Teldrassil's crown.

sections.title: A Voice in Dolanaar
sections.body: Syral Bladeleaf guides new arrivals through Dolanaar beneath Teldrassil's canopy. Speaking for the Council of the Forest, she sends night elves to village leaders and herbalists nearby. Her guidance leads travelers to Denalan, a botanist at Lake Al'Ameth, and helps them bring supplies to the village elders.

sections.title: Ties to the Village
sections.body: Syral carries out the Council of the Forest's work in Dolanaar. She helps medicinal elixirs reach those in need and makes sure disturbances to the local ecosystem receive swift attention.

faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf speaks for the Council of the Forest in Dolanaar and helps newcomers aid woodland communities.

faq.q: Where can Syral Bladeleaf be found?
faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf can be found in Dolanaar, Teldrassil's central settlement, just southwest of Shadowglen along the main road.

faq.q: What tasks does she assign to adventurers?
faq.answer: Syral sends travelers to help Denalan, the botanist at Lake Al'Ameth, arrange herbal elixirs for the elders, and aid Teldrassil's natural balance.

angles.text: As a young night elf leaving Shadowglen's secluded barrows, you meet Syral Bladeleaf, one of Dolanaar's first voices of civic and natural leadership.
As an herbalist, you can help Syral direct travelers to Denalan's botanical research at Lake Al'Ameth and make sure fresh elixirs reach the elders.
